coquette.note: Pink roses framing the scene, warm romantic light; the man stays a man.

kawaii.note: Pastel blooms, mint and pink, koi. Sweet without turning cartoon.

high_fantasy.note: Torches and lanterns, banners on the columns, a warm enchanted glow.

whimsical.note: Lanterns and drifting golden sparkles; playful.

surreal.note: Bright and colorful; the impossible touches did not land.

fierce.note: Warm windy golden light, hair and leaves moving.

voltage.note: Full neon magenta and cyan on a wet floor. Unmistakable.

ancient.note: Moss, overgrowth and aged stone; the glasshouse reclaimed.

macabre.note: Dark coat, moody lanterns; spooky-cute stripes did not appear.

shimmer.note: Bright, warm and flattering; a soft bloom at most.

minimal.note: Muted mist, quiet light, a black turtleneck. Calm and clean.

psychedelic.note: Kaleidoscope rainbow pattern across the whole glasshouse.
